name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_room_entered) and Existence(target_picked_up) are both hard, and each matches a separate sentence of the task. The second sentence has no order word, so no Precedence is required. The environment already makes entering the room a prerequisite for pickup, so the machine's order is correct without an extra clause.

texts: Get into the locked room: the agent must enter the room that contains the target ball.
Pick up the ball: the agent must pick up the mission's target ball.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3

(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u1
